content.title: About
content.content: Dove is a line of skin‑care products developed by Unilever. Dove items are known for their gentle formula that contains ¼ cream, providing deep moisturisation and skin protection. The range includes soaps, shower gels, lotions and creams suitable for daily use.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first Dove soap was launched in 1957 in the United States.
The brand positions itself around "Real Beauty", featuring people of diverse ages, body types and ethnicities in its advertising.
Dove formulas often contain microscopic ceramide particles that help restore the skin’s natural barrier.
Dove products are sold in more than 80 countries worldwide.
Unilever supports confidence‑building programs for teenagers through the "Real Beauty" initiative.

items.title: Moisturising
items.content: The ¼ cream content helps retain water in the outer epidermal layers, leaving skin soft and smooth.

items.title: Barrier protection
items.content: Ceramides and mild surfactants aid in rebuilding the skin’s natural barrier, reducing irritation.

items.title: Suitable for sensitive skin
items.content: Hypoallergenic formulas without strong fragrances make Dove a good choice for people with sensitive skin.

items.title: Reduces dryness
items.content: Regular use can lessen the feeling of tightness and flakiness after showering.

items.title: Soothing effect
items.content: Some variants contain aloe and vitamin E, which calm irritated skin.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to fragrances or preservatives used in certain Dove products.

items.title: Excessive moisturisation
items.content: For very oily skin, frequent use of cream‑rich formulas may increase greasiness.

items.title: Eye contact
items.content: Shower gels can cause eye irritation if they get into the eyes; rinse thoroughly.

items.title: Storage
items.content: Keep products in a dry place away from direct sunlight to prevent fragrance degradation.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Apply soap or gel to wet skin, lather, and rinse with warm water. After showering, apply lotions or creams to dry skin, massaging gently until fully absorbed. For best results, use products from the same line together.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store Dove products in their original packaging in a cool, dry place protected from direct sunlight. Keep caps tightly closed to avoid loss of fragrance.
